reviews.text: Pulled up with friends to chug straight beef, ended up eating 80 plates. Servers kept on bringing more meat. A happy birthday cake was brought out and the guy on my left folded. Already overstimulated 🤣🤣🤣 w chews. Atmosphere ruined by 2slimey.

Muhteşem bir deneyim. Ayrıca restoranın besinlerin ziyan edilmemesine verdikleri hassasiyet çok güzel. Hem az tüketmeye hem de doğru planlama yapıp yavaş yemenize sebep oldu. Teşekkürler. Yine geleceğiz.

Food and service here was really good. Our grills were changed 3x. Our meats and sides were fresh and did not taste frozen. We loved the brisket, ribs, squid and pineapple. Just wished the ventilation was better. The sauce station was pretty clean. Great variety and flavors here.

We’ve been going here for 2 years now and in the beginning it was wonderful but recently they decreased the time limit from 2 hours to 1.5 hours and the food has gone down in quality. We usually order beef and chicken and the chicken cuts we mostly tendon and the beef was rather under-seasoned, their sauce bar was also a mess this last visit

My partner and I have been going here for 3 years for birthdays and celebrations. The food was always great, but apparantly at some point they decreased the dinner time limit from 2 hours to 90 minutes. They didn't inform us of the new time limit until the ordering tablet locked at the 80 minute mark, and a waiter informed us that we'd have to pay extra for more food. We left hungry after spending 45$ each post tax and tip. I feel scammed. Definitely not coming back after tonight.

99 flavor has fallen off a cliff. Food is terrible now. I would HIGHLY recommend not coming if you want quality hotpot. I shared feedback with the server that the broth and food and quality has declined a lot and he was defensive and not helpful. Will not come back.

La comida estaba bien, lo bueno es que puedes armar tu salsa según te guste. Solo pedimos la opción de hot pot y fue una experiencia agradable. Si no les gusta nada picante les recomiendo el caldo de pata de cerdo.
Always a great time at 99! Can’t wait for my next visit. 🤤

ive been on my period and i cried the other day bc someone took my parking spot and then i didn't want to go to class anyway bc this guy is there and he's just making me feel every flavor of awful, so i needed iron. this wasn't a bad price bc the average is around 40, but you def pay for it. idk, i think my brother and i genuinely suck at cooking the meat here? like we've been fine at other places but they didn't give us full heat at first and then it was mega difficult to cut the meat bc the scissors are like weird? props to our poor server who saw us struggle for a bit and had to cut in and do everything, I'm so sorry, we're like really dumb and bad lmao. the meat was good tho, i liked the cubes!! and they let you have a free ice cream, but the only flavor they had was strawberry? bruh. and don't say it's bc we ate there late, bc we didn't?? it was like 4?? idk

Incredibly racist establishment they don’t have any sort of customer service. They just placed an iPad on your table along with the food. They don’t explain anything to you, but expect a tip in addition to rushing enforcing you out of the restaurant within a 90 minute timeframe that they do not disclose until the timer rings on the iPad they took my passport to verify my birthday after they already handed me my candles and rushed my birthday song and then proceeded to do three other birthday Songs consecutively after mine there’s no sort of customer service at the establishment, especially if you are of a POC. I will be making your review online and requesting a refund because this service was insane and the food’s not that good anyway management can reach out to me before I post this to my audience online you know who you are.
Really nice and high quality food, you are your own chef so it was cooked to my own liking! The rice was good and the seats were very comfortable! Staff was also nice
Good time with friends, highly recommend for groups! Strong variety in hot pot choices
Something needs changing. Figure it out

Came here for my birthday with my family of 4 one day after my birthday.  Website states "you may come in up to three days before or after your birthday for free but we require that it is with a party of 4 or more".  They wouldn't honor the birthday discount because my kids were minors.  Nowhere on their website does it say party of 4 must be adults.  We've been coming here for years and have never encountered this with the birthday promo.  Seemed like they made up this adults only rule on the spot to not give discount.  The food has also gone downhill, the seafood isn't fresh and  green vegetables were wilted.  We will not be coming back anymore.

Nachdem wir verschiedene chinesische Restaurants erkundet hatten, blieben wir schliesslich im 99 Favor Taste in Chinatown „hängen“ – und das war ein echter Glückstreffer!

Der Hot Pot, den wir bereits von unseren Asienreisen kannten, sprach uns sofort an. Innerhalb kürzester Zeit bekamen wir vier einen grossen Tisch und bestellten zusätzlich noch das Barbecue. Dann begann ein wahres Festessen: Unmengen an frischem Hühner- und Rindfleisch, knackigem Gemüse, Nudeln, Reis und weiteren Köstlichkeiten wurden serviert – alles zum Grillieren und Garen direkt an unserem Tisch.

Das Essen war einfach fantastisch, die Auswahl riesig und die Portionen mehr als grosszügig. Besonders viel Spass hatten wir beim gemeinsamen Kochen, Grillieren und Ausprobieren an unseren Hot Pots und dem Tischgrill. Ein geselliger, unterhaltsamer und ausgesprochen leckerer Abend!

Für rund 40 Dollar pro Person erhielten wir ein grossartiges Erlebnis und mehr als genug ausgezeichnetes Essen. Wer Hot Pot und Barbecue liebt oder einmal ausprobieren möchte, sollte dieses Restaurant unbedingt besuchen!
Amazing food, free icecream at the end !!!
差评

My fav hot pot and Korean bbq spot!
Everything is fresh, prices are extremely affordable and the staff is super sweet.

This place is nice BUT if you never had Kpot before dont let here be your first time. This is for those that already know how things should work. The service was good the sauces were good. I had no idea how I should have ordered the soups but user error so I simply decided to do rice then have the guys BBQ the food as everything tasted better that way. Then the soju is amazing.  Now let's talk about seating. I like the down stairs steating rather than the private rooms but if you are looking for the authentic experience get the room. The bench surrounds the entire table and you are elevated.

The dumplings tasted amazingggggggg

Oh and surprise surprise if you are driving they actually have street parking out front that's available

The dining experience was absolutely wonderful! 🤩
The staff paid close attention to our needs at all times. Dishes were served quickly, and our water glasses were always kept full. Staff assisted us with grilling, changed the grill plate immediately once it got charred, and kept the hot‑pot from boiling dry. There was a great variety of dipping sauces. The wait time was short, and the 90‑minute dining window was more than enough — we were never rushed. Overall, it was an amazing experience!👍🍖🍲

I used to go here at least once a year. The quality of the food has seriously gone downhill. The sauce bar seemed really gross, like it was sitting for a long time and accumulating bacteria. The meat tasted bad or was super tough. I hate to say it, but I no longer recommend it and won’t be back. Kpot is much better and a similar price.

The service was very good though I have to wonder how they can have so much staff and the set up was relatively comfortable.

They may have included tip for only 2 people.

Went here for my birthday with me and my partner. They run a deal where the birthday person eats free. After receiving my bill, they added AUTO gratuity without informing me, for a total of $13. The bill was $62 BEFORE removing the birthday meal (31), and somehow ended up being $51 after tip + tax?? This is over a 40% gratuity before taxes. There was NO signage or information from the staff about this, and I come here every year! Completely took advantage of me, and I'm pretty sure this is ILLEGAL. Will not be coming back after this and suggest you do the same.

Not sure if this is a new policy, but it is NOT communicated on their site or by their staff, making it illegal. It is a very predatory practice.

Note: They say citations are at the desk and on the table, this is a lie as I literally have PHOTOS. The fact that they confirmed they do not tell you about this proves they are doing shady tactics. Please do not do business here anymore. I will be disputing this charge.

I googled for Chinese food and this placed popped up.  It is actually a Korean BBQ.  Although it wasn't what I was looking for, as a tourist I had no regrets! It was delicious and the staff was phenomenal! They help each other out and it was nice of them to always stop by ensure your meat does not burn and cut it as well. $35 for BBQ, $40 for both hot pot and BBQ.
I'll sure visit again when I'm back in town!

We’ve been here two times, and we really enjoy it! My friends and I are hot pot lovers, and 99 Favor is reasonably priced. We love that it’s free on your birthday. There is a good variety of meats, veggies, and staple foods. We didn’t like the mystery meat though😅 Overall, we’ll definitely come back!
Pretty good authentic hotpot, but no duck blood!

The food and atmosphere was great, my only issue is that we had a large party of about 16 ppl and we were not allowed to be seated at one or two of the large "private" rooms (its really 1 long room with 3 separate entry doors, for a total of 3 sitting areas which seat about 12 ppl) even though we had a reservation. So we had to split the party into 2 at back-to-back booths which was less then ideal. If we were allowed to sit in the private room it would have been much easier to socialize with the entire group (no walls between the 3 sections). So honestly we basically operated as 2 separate parties and barely got to intermingle

Very good restaurant
all employees very friendly ❤️❤️❤️

99 Favor Taste is a great place to go with a few friends. I went yesterday for the all-you-can-eat BBQ and hot pot, and we had an amazing time. It's the perfect place to catch up with old friends, enjoy good food, and just bond together. The staff was friendly and even helped us with the BBQ, which made the experience even better. If you're looking for a fun group dinner, I'd definitely recommend checking this place out!

Policies are extremely inconsistent and I was not allowed to leave until I was forced to tip. The restaurant just felt as if they were using cheap tricks to obligate you into spending more money. Its also 40$ per person if you get BBQ + Hot Pot which is not told to you anywhere before you pay. The food was mediocre at best and nothing was particularly great. Service was fine but the employees were acting like they were being held hostage and forced to work. Very cold atmosphere. Overall, I left extremely unsatisfied and will not be going to Favor Taste again.
Food was mid and servings did not justify being $40 per person. Prices were misleading

This was my third time here, and it will definitely be my last. Every time I’ve visited, the staff acted like they were serving customers against their will, with no friendliness at all. I ignored it because the food was okay before.

This time, the food was terrible. It looked carelessly thrown together, and we couldn’t even finish it.

I have no problem leaving a tip when it’s deserved. What bothered me was that after I paid and was about to leave, they called me back and suddenly told me tipping was mandatory because it was the restaurant’s policy. Strangely, no one ever mentioned this during my previous visits, and this time I was basically forced to pay it after arguing with them.

Terrible food, poor service, and inconsistent policies. I won’t be coming back.

I'm posting this review for awareness. I tried to come here by myself for the birthday deal. Nowhere on their website does it say you need two people. I explained that when I walked in and the two people at the front just showed me the card.

I do think having one person pay and the other be free for a birthday is a good deal. But please, put it on your damn website!!
Foods and service is bad

I really love this hot pot and BBQ buffet; they offer a wide variety of options for both hot pot and BBQ food. In the back section, there is an assortment of sauces, snacks, and fresh fruit to satisfy a diverse range of tastes. The dining environment is spacious and comfortable, making it an ideal spot for family gatherings.
Really bad quality and owners seem greedy with all of their policies. Save yourself the headache and go elsewhere
They will rob you. 2/4 people out of table at bbq charged us for all 4

I came here for my birthday. Made a reservation and everything. When i arrived they said the party before us was taking a while and they couldnt seat us. They told us this AFTER making us wait for 20 minutes. So instead of having everyone at one table like originally planned and promised, we were forced to split up across 4 tables (they also made us move after we were seated, cause why not right?).

How do you as a business not honor a reservation? On top of that, they were so rude while we were waiting, and the manager herself practically laughed in our face about this situation. It was so embarrassing and disrespectful, the treatment we got. I really wanted to enjoy this place and my birthday but was met with unprofessional attitudes and just plain chaos. Ill never come back here and would highly recommend you avoid it as well.
经济实惠，好吃，值得推荐

I'm not someone who typically writes dramatic reviews, but this experience was extremely disappointing.

I stopped by for the complimentary birthday meal that I've enjoyed here for the past several years. In the past, if you came in on your actual birthday, you could receive the birthday meal even if you were dining alone. I've always tipped 20%+ based on the full menu value and have also dined at your restaurants as a paying customer on many other occasions.

When I arrived, a supervisor at the front told me the policy had changed and said I should have checked the website beforehand. I pulled up the website on the spot and showed her that it had not been updated to reflect the new policy. She acknowledged that the website was inaccurate, but simply shrugged.

I politely explained that I had checked the website before making the trip and that it should be updated to avoid situations like this. Her demeanor then became noticeably dismissive.

Being turned away on my birthday after commuting there and looking forward to dinner was unnecessarily frustrating and, frankly, felt a bit petty.
Quality and service is still just as good, and they have both outdoor and indoor dining available.

Sauce station felt dirty, mala soup base was lacking in spice, water was warm, floors were slippery, and no buffet bar (selection two things). The 8th Ave 99 Favor is superior in all ways except food.

Its not just all you can eat hotpot buffet. They even have individual hotpot !! Everything is great including the service, the only downside is you only get one ice cream cup per person 😭😭😭 for dessert.

I’ve been to this location several times. the quality and service is not great as it used to be. There are far better hotpot bbq options in the city.

They need to add a safety lock for the induction cooktops for parties that do not order hotpot. The stove top is in Chinese and can be easily turned on by mistake.. this is safety hazard.

Recently revisited this place after many years. Very disappointed overall. The food / quality of meat was very mediocre. Soup base is not great. Service was prompt, but limited to 90 minutes of dining time. The price for all you can eat is slightly cheaper compared to other all you can eat hotpot / bbq places, but I would have paid slightly more for better quality ingredients.
Food is good, service is decent. Place gets crowded.
Some of the best AYCE hotpot and k-bbq around. Love this place. Highly recommend a reservation for dinner time with larger groups. Love their options and everything is so fresh and clean.

The service here is absolutely immaculate. From the lightning-fast pace to the proactive water refills, the staff truly goes above and beyond. We opted for both the hot pot and BBQ; everything arrived at the table quickly, and the team even stepped in to grill for us while we focused on the hot pot. With incredible flavors and a vibrant atmosphere, this spot is top-notch. Highly recommended!

Love trying new food experiences. All of the food was extremely fresh and the service was very fast. A great place to go with big groups who can eat a lot of food. The options are endless and the drinks are top teir. The only advice I have is e prepared to wait. Made reservations weeks in advance, arrive on time, and still had to wait 20 mins to get seated. Other than that it was fantastic!!
We usually came at flushing branch. Tried at this location for dinner AYCE. Reservation is recommended. Fast service and recommended.

The service was actually horrific. I came here for a friend's birthday dinner and they messed up the reservation even though my friend had called the day of to reconfirm everything. They couldn't fit the whole party at a table, the waiters were very rude didn't explain how to order and then cleaned up without asking if we were finished. There was a whole fiasco with the bill because they didn't bill us properly and then were rude when IDing my friend to get the birthday discount. They tried to rush us out. To add insult to injury they, forgot to bring out the birthday cake and when they did bring it out, it was uncut. They made my friend, the birthday girl, feel bad because of THEIR INCOMPETENCE. Sure the food was good but not good enough to overlook this terrible treatment. Never returning again.

I've been coming to this restaurant since j was 25 years old I've come here to celebrate birthdays graduations job promotions etc etc but just as of 2/12/26 my enter the restaurant to enjoy herself for her birthday. She enter got herself a table and proceeded to eat when I was time to pay her bill she surprised to find out they was charging her she presented her I.D and ask how come she's not getting her meal for free and management tell her she has to have a person with her on her birthday day. My mother proceeded to pay her bill and leave this restaurant NEEDS to fix there official website to make sure things like this don't happen in the future. The food staff the atmosphere is fantastic and great my issue is with management and upper management fix this issue you're better than this thank you.

Horrible spot we celebrated my friend’s birthday last night at their private room. It was my first time there there and one stove was open in beginning and the food was barely cooking. We kept telling them it’s not working and the flame was not high enough. They acted uninterested and slow about situation. I finally had to speak up and gotangry because we were eating raw meat. I had to tell them to open second stove and at the end just 30 mins left the flame was not even high enough to cook our food they had to cook it somewhere else. We spent over $700 for uncooked food and horrible service. I will never come back to this place.

I got the hotpot, and the food was scrumptious! Especially the tofu skin and fishballs! There was also free fried mantou dessert at the sauce station so yay to that! However, the sauce game here is a little weak and lacking in variety but that’s ok!
The food was pretty bad and was rushed to leave.

This is an embarrassing place. Food took over 45 min to get to our table.

Fun fact, if you dont tip to their standards they chase you out and claim a 15% tip is the standard. Absolutely disgusting. Do not eat here or their other locations.

The food also sucked.
Wow what a great spot! Set prices for kpot and Korean BBQ!!! Everything was so delicious

Imagine going to a hot pot place and having the base soup you chose be absolutely tasteless.
Had to add our own salt.
Extremely disappointing

Bad customer service:

I asked for a fork for my non-chopstick using friend and they pointed me to an area with utensils but there was only knives there.

They did not restock the ice cream and then yelled at my friend and me when I tried to restock it for them, only to put the boxes back and NOT restock them, leading another patron to restock. They did not approach them (probably because of skin tone)

No table service, took forever to get water refills. And they asked if we were done, didn’t wait for an answer and turned off the heat.

Check the heat of your grill! They intentionally leave it low so that the meat takes a long time to cook to reduce the amount of food you get. I added a picture, if you can do it yourself— turn it to the red characters.
Very poor quality ingredients. Broth loaded with salt oil and MSG felt sick for days
decent all u can eat hotpot
Had a table reserved but they made us wait 30 minutes anyway, service could have been better but food was great
For the price and quality, this is one of the better hot pot places I’ve been to. Service was fast when some items that we ordered were missing. I will definitely be coming back!

Probably the worst hot pot experience I’ve ever had. Were ordered 1 round of food and then never got anything else after that round. We told the waiter and he told us to order again and still good did not come. Then after 90 minutes they gave us the check and we didn’t get anything else after food beyond our first round.

I used to go to this restaurant with my friends on the weekends and have a blast, the servers were helpful and the meal wasn’t too expensive. Things have changed drastically. I thought I could bring my family for my mom’s 65th birthday. And from the moment we sat down the servers seemed completely disinterested, unhelpful and handed me a tablet to order, which was fine but when I asked for assistance because this was a new process for my parents, they barely cared. In fact, they kept saying “the price is the same” when I never asked them about the price and that felt like a micro aggressive racist way to speak to a black patron. Additionally they sat us next to the kitchen and regularly stood by our table but were conveniently busy whenever we had a question. This version of 99FavorTaste is nothing like I remembered, just seemed like an airport diner that didn’t care about what was actually going on aside from bussing people in and out. Our food never really got cooked and we still ended up paying $200+ for barely any service. I thought it would be great because birthdays eat free but the bill was still huge.

This was extremely disappointing and in times like this where people are spending their hard earned money to dine well, this feels like we were taken for our money and really ruined my mom’s birthday dinner.

I also want to say the lack of help from the service staff was baffling, we barely ate any food and the meat that did get cooked tasted funny even after we had it on the grill for a long while.

Be wary of eating here.
Food was great, service was good, place was kinda stuffy during peak hours. Great if you just want to stuff yourself. Overall a bit pricey but a solid spot to eat a lot with your friends

I really enjoyed my experience at 99 Favor Taste. For both hot pot and BBQ, the price was around $60–$80, though I added an extra person so I’m not 100% sure. The customer service was amazing staff were very helpful, especially since I had only done hot pot before and wasn’t too familiar with grilling. They walked me through everything, which made the experience even better.

Overall, it was a great meal with a fun atmosphere. I’d definitely recommend this spot to anyone who wants a good dining experience without breaking the bank. Just be mindful not to leave too much food leaving about ½ to 1 pound can result in an additional charge (I believe it’s under $25).

Really enjoyed this hot pot place. The broth was rich and flavorful, ingredients were fresh, and the sauce bar had great options. Cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and a fun, satisfying meal overall. Definitely worth coming back to! They rock.. I was way tooo full and content in the best way

Essen war ganz OK.
Die Dame am Empfang sehr unfreundlich!
Wir waren zum ersten mal da, und sie hatte keine Lust uns zu erklären was der Unterschied ist der verschiedenen Menues!
Haben dann trotzdem etwas Trinkgeld gegeben seil es ja in den USA üblich ist.
Kein Dankeschön, kein aufwiedersehen, nichts!
Arroganz pur! Obwohl das Essen ganz Ok war, hat die Dame am Empfang das Ganze etwas unfreudig gemacht! Evtl ist das die Besitzerin oder Managerin was auch immer, so geht man nicht mit Gästen um!

Worst experience of racism and discrimination my boyfriend went in by himself and he had the worst experience ever. They made him wait for more den an hour just because he was by himself. Multiple people walked in after him without reservations and got sat within 5-10 minutes. (The restaurant was not busy) When he went to ask the lady how much longer they walked away from him and didn’t acknowledge him. After he got sat after more than an hour he ordered one round of meat for his bbq and they turned off his heat. He asked why his heat was off if they can turn it back on and he was ignored. That’s when he ordered his second round of meat which took more den 30+ minutes for them to bring it out. The short rib was tangy and slimy like it was expired or left out. If you plan on coming here rethink that bring your business elsewhere.
Great service, reliable quality, lots of options for hot pot.
Solid hot pot, good sauce bar options and post meal dessert.
Great price point have been coming here for years during the holidays when we don't feel like cooking.
Awesome place. Great prices, even eating free on your birthday. And the hotpot and bbq are equally incredible. Worth a try, absolutely.

NOT FOR BIRTHDAYS.

I've been waiting to come to this location for a few months now, I had tried one in Brooklyn and was somewhat dissatisfied with the food quality so I figured I would try this one to give it a shot again. I came at 10 P.M with lots of hope, sat down and the food was somehow worse in comparison to it's sister location in Brooklyn. The steak and meat seem ok but for 30 bucks it seems pretty low quality. The atmosphere is ok, it's loud but the service is ok. It's typical AYCE servers with some being more attending than others. My issue laid was at the end when paying, it was 20 minutes off of being my birthday and I was charged entirely full price and told that I was not going to be given any deal. I was surprised as I had called this location prior to check and I also assumed since it would officially be my birthday in 15 minutes when I paid. it would not be a massive deal, my partner who accompanied me comes here very often biweekly so I was astonished they would fight me over something that is a courtesy like birthday especially as he's a regular. Overall I'm really disappointed and annoyed me and my friends will not be back at this location for our upcoming birthday's and celebrations.
They told us the waiting was going to be 30 min, we waited 2 hours and they never sit us!  I get the place is busy but 2 hours?? for a table for 2!
Very mediocre cuts of meat. Went on a Saturday night and it was so understaffed we had to cook the meat ourselves and ask servers multiple times for forgotten items.
So yummy! Thank you for a great dinner and amazing hospitality!

Their website says that you can get a free meal on your birthday, but you arrive and it’s only with a party of two. No mention of that on the website. Arrived by myself and was turned away. No idea how the food was, I’ll never know.
Beware tip is calculated with tax included in the price.

Where do i begin, the customer service from the lady made my day. The food and options are endless and the food tastes amazing. Jina and our server were super mice and friendly. Will definitely be back
The food was good we got hot pot and bbq

They no longer honor the birthday special as described on the website.

You can no longer eat free on your birthday if you're dining by yourself. Apparently you must have 2 other people minimum.

NEVER have I ever experienced the WORST hot pot in my entire life. First we were seated at the table and they kept rushing us multiple times to order soup base but we were still looking at the menu. We finally order our soup base and other menu items and the server basically disappeared. One of the servers come back and ask what soup bases we order and then leaves but comes back with meat and we are still waiting for the soup base. Soup base should be the first food item that comes out. Secondly, the wifi was awful and none of the food items were ordered except for the meat through so we had to reorder. We had to wait 20 more minutes after the meat was served to get our soup bases but even after that the rest of the food never came until a server came back to ask if we had ordered anything else. None of the servers looked like they knew what they were doing except one. When the food finally there were not only extra servings of food we never ordered but also we received a plate of food that was meant for another table. One of our party members ordered rice cakes and never received it for at least 40 minutes until we asked. We asked a server for spoons for the hot pot because every other table received these spoons except for us. We asked for five of these spoons; however, not only did we receive the wrong spoons (normal soup spoons not made for hot pot), but we also only got three instead of five. Nobody comes back and refills our water the whole time until at least an hour and a half later (by the server who actually looks like he knows what he is doing). Also, one server knocked over one of our party member’s water cup and never apologized. They never gave a proper introduction or told us about any gratuity or time limit, so after two hours the server rudely drops the bill on the table without a word. Nobody gives us time checks. The customer service was terrible. We did not have a good time and were constantly stressed about getting the proper food items. How can self order ayce hot pot place have the worst customer service?? It’s worse because the servers were not even rude but just terrible at their job. I would never recommend this place and would never come here again.
99 flavors, 99 favors

Decent food at a decent price. The baskets they served the ingredients in were incredibly gross and not cleaned well—with caked on food, oily residue, and lots of the plastic
clearly falling apart. Staff was nice and the place was relatively empty.

We love Hotpot and have been coming here for many years and on my Bday as well. This year was incredibly disappointing  as the service was incredibly bad. They checked my ID twice at the front and when they were mumbling about the bday special, I spoke with them in Mandarin where they quickly acknowledged and seated us. Then after the meal, they tried to charge us full price DESPITE our server stating throughout the meal that my dinner would be covered. They then checked by ID a 3rd time before they corrected the check. It just felt a bit shady and sneaky.... Then they finally played the bday song for me when my wife asked for it nearly an hour before. It sounds like the new management have been causing this chaos  with some underhanded new policies/tactics to trick their customers. Please do better. No desire to report this establishment but if it keeps going like this, there may not be another choice.
We came here many many years ago. We introduced our friends here as well. She went recently and said that she was able to get a free meal since it was her birthday!

99 Favor Taste is a well oiled machine, and for that, I return time and time again for the past 5 years! It’s a constant clock work of good quickly coming out, broth arriving hot and flavorful to immediately cook, and constant clearing of the tables. Portions are small so you can order so many different things! Eyes are kept on the broth level and constant refilled. Love you guys so much!!

We went there around 6pm and got a seat easily. The food was truly fab! If you are a fan of sichuan flavors and numbing spice this is for you! I am a vegetarian and I had loads of options to choose from. We got the spicy broth, and it was not a lie!
Great for birthdays

For anyone wanting to go for their birthday, just to let you know that they’ve changed their policy and require at least a party of 2 on your birthday to get a free meal. Additionally, when I went by myself I felt like the workers were watching me the entire time and it was slightly uncomfortable.

This place was perpetually crowded so we'd s schlep down to Hometown BBQ instead.

But this some we were lucky. I hate to complain but I was shocked to discover they were lacking in the condiment area. They didn't have a lot of the same stuff that you'd see at at most K Pot places I also felt the meat was chewy.

I always want everything to be a home run but that's not all the case. 99 Favor Taste was ok but the visit made us wish we went to Hometown BBQ instead. It wasn't terrible!

But it wasn't worth feeling bad for missing out all those other times when I went to Hometown because this place was too crowded.

Came here for lunch on a weekday and was pretty nice, now let’s get to it:

Hot pot or bbq?

We chose hot pot and it didn’t disappoint !
Menu selection was great as you can see from all the various plates we have on the table. My friend was super excited to eat everything from beef, lamb, to enoki mushrooms and tofu skin.

Staff were very attentive and service was fast but it was only us and maybe 4 other families.

Heads up: Ordering is off the phone through a QR scan and directs to a website.

Just ate here not my best experience since I’ve been going to the location for years now!! Today’s service was not it I have big curl hair and my friends one had their hair tied with a scarf the other have a wavy bob length hair which goes to her shoulders…. There’s was a very long pin straight black hair in one of our seafood… upon tell the worker who was help us just took the hair and left the sea food on the table as if we’re suppose to still eat that! (Big side eye) The shoulder shrug and the pointing and laugh of staff is what ended with the night No Tip we found it rude and overall disrespectful!!! The food is great but it makes me wonder about their sanitary conditions!

Avoid this place if you need time to review the menu or finalize your order.

We arrived around 8:45 PM, and our experience was rushed from the start. My friend went to the restroom while we were still browsing the menu. Our server, R, repeatedly pressured us to place an order, even after we explained we needed more time. She kept insisting that we had until 10:30, but her constant interruptions made us feel rushed and uncomfortable.

I’ve visited this establishment many times before, but this was the first time I felt treated as if we were in a “to-go” situation instead of dining in.

I hope management addresses this issue to improve the dining experience for others.
The bbq itself is pretty decent. The lamb was probably the best cut of meat. The seafood pancake was so good we ordered a second.

I had a terrible experience. Before I absolutely loved this place and couldn’t wait to go back, but now it feels dead and gloomy. Our server didn’t want to interact with us remotely and they EXCHANGED THE GRILL WHILE WE WERE EATING! The wire touched our food and cups and it wasn’t even clean or anything, had lots of dirt and gunk on it and made us super uncomfortable. We didn’t want to eat much after.

I’m not coming back and wouldn’t recommend to anyone. It’s a shame, because I really loved this place, it had a lot of energy but now just seems run down.

The soup base is not tasty, the variety of ingredients is limited, there is almost no service, the tip is 18%, the sauce is poor, there are no fruits during the day, and only a few oranges after 5 p.m. It's a miracle that such a restaurant can be opened in Manhattan. It's hard to imagine that it's still open despite such bad food！
Terrible service, food is subpar, they do not cook the BBQ for you. Food takes forever to come out
Great AYCE restaurant in nyc, good vibe, stuffs are very nice, if ur having a birthday you need to come with a friend on the exactly day, otherwise u would need a party of 4. And shout out for caden!
I love going here with the people that I care about. It's SUCH A GOOD DEAL!
The food is delicious the sauces are great they even cook it for you if you want the choices are so many and the meat is quality love this place!!
got food poisoning

Got sick and a sore throat after eating here, the single hot pot pots were dirty, and so were a lot of the utensils. The water also tasted kind of dirty and gross too. Our whole group (all Chinese btw) felt weird after eating, either got sore throats or stomach issues. Wouldn’t recommend

We visited 99 Favor Taste for my husband's birthday. We had never been to a hotpot or barbecue specific restaurant and now we know what we were missing out on. We prefer to eat vegetarian food and this restaurant had so many options for us. We highly recommend the bread sticks, potato vermicelli, fried tofu skin, egg plant (for BBQ) and would avoid the lotus root and corn which were difficult to cook and eat. They even offer a few free appetizers and a free ice cream. The collection of sauces was great. We ordered through a tab and they charge for wastage of too much food, so be careful how much you order. The vibe of the place is pretty and all the servers were very helpful. We did get the birthday offer (one person eats free) but they do not wish or give anything else. The place is priced high if not for the birthday offer, so going very hungry will help you do justice.
Good stuff
My favorite BBQ and hotpot spot in New York! Tons of options, great quality, and the best part — you get to enjoy both BBQ and hotpot in one place. Surprisingly affordable too. Highly recommend!

I have been going to this place for years. Unfortunately they changed management around 3 months ago and it is just not the same. The restaurant was on the empty side, when it used to always be busy no matter when it was. They changed policies and required everyone at the table to have the same meal type. And where they used to honor birthdays (free meal of bbq and hotpot) they changed their policy to be a party of 4(for each birthday person). This is not written out clearly on their website, nor their signs/business cards. Sometimes we go with multiple peoples birthdays in the same time period, and usually they all eat for free. When we went, as a party of 6, they only let one birthday person have their meal for free, when there were 3 people who were in the birthday realm of 3 days apart. They also put an automatic gratuity of 20%. The waitstaff are nice and this is nothing against them at all. However the policy changes need to be updated, especially since they are different than they once were and the words aren’t clear. The price for value/quality does not compare to other AYCE hotspot and bbq places so it just doesn’t make sense to go here anymore for one person to eat free. We are better off going somewhere with higher quality meats and an all around better experience if we were going to pay that much. It felt blind sighting to find out these changes at the end when the bill came and they asked about birthdays. The manager kept apologizing for the changes that were not clearly stated and applied a $5 discount on the second persons birthday.

Never returning again. The manager/boss lady was so rude and promotions are lies. They need new management ASAP. Go somewhere else it’s more worth it. The waitstaff were very nice! It’s not the same experience as a few months ago with the new management. Not suitable for large groups and long waits. DON’T GO HERE!

One of the best hot pots I've ever had hands down.  The mushroom broth is an absolute 10/10 the service is great for rookies and veterans of KBBQ and the options are great!  The all you can eat pricing includes their sauce bar and practically everything on the menu so its absolutely worth the price for what you get!
Not recommended.In 2025 now they don’t really do any birthday specials for the person and birthdays don’t eat free and every 1 pound left of food is extra $12.00.
Great food
It’s neat they offer individual hot pots in case you don’t want to mix everything. KBBQ and hotpot combo was cool. Meats seemed good quality. For the AYCE price it’s definitely a good deal.
Selection isn't what it used to be. Servers sat us down and didn't mention closing time and kept trying to rush us out. We weren't trying to take our time, but wanted to get our money's worth.
Fun time, good food, and excellent service.
It’s sad they r closing everywhere.. may b they need to level up their menu ..

The food was good, but we had a party with strict dietary restrictions that were not fully respected by the staff. They tried to cook the food for us multiple times despite us asking them not to and cross-contaminated the foods we were attempting to avoid touching. Part of the KBBQ experience is cooking the food yourself, so it was extremely disappointing and frustrating that we were barely given the opportunity to do so and caused some of our friends to not able to fully enjoy the meal they were paying for.
去了2次都是上完水之后就没有人管你了，烤盘烧焦了半天叫不到人.点菜也是点几份就上一份.第一次以为忙没空搭理.第二次去还是这样以后不会再去了.不管有没有服务你 结账时候小费都要给.火锅的东西很少吃烤肉选择的还是比较多

Awesome. The food was amazing and this time we did BBQ and hotpot. The hotpot was mild spicy for me and I loved it. Mild spicy really is just very spicy though. That's still fine. I still prefer BBQ. The House sauce is one of the best sauces I’ve ever had in my life. It's absolutely perfect for the meat.
Food is very good and hotpot was worth the price. The restaurant itself looked clean and very nice. The workers weren't always that attentive but some were kind.
Fast efficient and delicious. Great date spot and a lot of fun with friends.
This place used to be decent a few years ago ago, now it’s gone much worse. Food, hygiene, and service are all quite bad. The price is still decent but not even worth it anymore.

Absolutely awful. We got the BBQ AYCE and it was a bad experience. The food quality was low. The service was very pushy and rude. In these kind of places you expect to have your time and talk but they kept barging in and rushing us. They were very unpleasant and it was very tough to communicate with them as they don’t speak English, and I’m not talking about an accent, they just don’t speak it. I’m not a native and I had huge problem talking with them. I’m giving it a 1 star since there are better options in NYC like in Korea Town. There you can have better food and service around the same price point. Don’t waste your time.

My friends and I made reservations for someone's birthday. We were to be seated at 8pm. When we arrived, we were shown to a table that seated 4 people, despite our reservation being for 6. The staff decided to bring two metal chairs and shove them between another party eating at the end of the table. There was no room to even pull out the chairs to take a seat as the restaurant was packed and  it is a saturday night. I told the staff member this was unacceptable, and we would like to be seated for for the correct amount on the reservation. We were told that we would need to wait an additional twenty minutes. We promptly canceled our reservation and went to eat at a nearby restaurant who was able to seat us immediately with six actual chairs. This was my first experience with this restaurant and I will never return based on the service provided tonight.
Always a great time. This is a staple for birthdays among my friends.

Don’t recommend for bbq at all! We had a group of 10 and the entire experience felt so strange. There was no direction & we had to go ask for our waiter to come back to our table anytime we needed anything. Also, the food itself was just not good - the meats weren’t seasoned, there were no side dishes, and the sauces lacked flavour. There are so many better AYCE spots in the city, strongly encourage checking those out before coming here.

I have very high standards when it comes to hotpot, and I really didn't enjoy this place. The only positive is the price—it's very affordable for an AYCE option in Manhattan. However, the food quality is just average; nothing stood out, and there weren't many options for either meat or vegetables.

Additionally, the sauce station didn't feel clean or well-organized. The sauce bowls were scattered randomly, and the area looked a bit messy. Even though it's cheap, I personally wouldn't return lol

I’d been visiting their Brooklyn location for years, but when Brooklyn closed for renovation, I went here.

I wish I could say it was fun, but I hated it.  The portions shrunk and the checks were higher.  It turned me off to all of their locations.
Terrible service
Yummy
It was the Best i wish to go back〈😆ノ
Worst experience. Waiter was unable to tell us how to order. Hated everything about this place. Customer service is non existent.
It’s hot pot, a little pricy. Good sauce selection. There are better places but this is like the standard.
Come here for your birthday. It’s the best.

I love hotpot, and have been coming to this place since 2023. I went with 3 friends and before we left, we paid and left whatever tip we college students could afford. The employee DEMANDED that we pay the lowest tip suggestion (18%) even after paying more than $160 all together. They wanted more money from us even after we agreed to tip 15%.
The waitress is sooo rude
很糟糕从此不会再来
I love hot pot food for my birthday 🎂
C'était très bon, original mais très bruyant. Pas bcp d'explication et peu de communication.

It’s all you can eat and we got there at 6:30 pm and there are so many stuff sold out such as crab, some meatball, mushroom and tripe. It’s just quite unfair we pay full price but they can have like so many item sold out without noticing us.
$38 all you can eat hotpot and $47 if you want to include bbq; not the most extensive selection of ingredients but has most of the good stuff!! Was pleased that they had pretty lean beef!

Definitively the type of place a group of friends will enjoy, I made the mistake of coming on a busy Friday night with a SO but in spite of that, the service was decent, and the workers helped me out because it was very clear that I was new to KBBQ, my cocktail was super tasty, and everything we ordered was pretty good, especially our popcorn chicken appetizer. Definitely deserves another visit, ideally with a group!
My favorite Hot Pot  ever !!!!!!!
Very delicious food, only complaint is they played the happy birthday song like 5 times and it was annoying. Otherwise great and would go back

AYCE hot pot with a variety of different meats and vegetables. Nothing outstanding, but good value and decent quality if you want to gorge yourself on hot soup and food on a frigid night.

Just make sure you get there on time (or let them know you'll be running late) if you do reserve... they really watch the clock
DO NOT GO UNLESS YOU WANT TO GET FOOD POISONING 🤮🤮🤮
Good food for all you can eat. Wide range of selection for hot pot and bbq

- Service was terrible. Didn’t refill water. Didn’t get what we ordered.
- Restroom are in terrible condition.
- food quality was okay.

Food and service here was really good. Our grills were changed 3x. Our meats and sides were fresh and did not taste frozen. We loved the brisket, ribs, squid and pineapple. Just wished the ventilation was better. The sauce station was pretty clean. Great variety and flavors here. The seating here was comfortable. I'll definitely be back to try their hot pot.

A pretty decent AYCE hotpot spot in Chinatown. I love that they always have a thing to celebrate birthdays. Pretty quick service overall. The ambiance of the place is a typical hotpot spot where everyone can have a good time!

Food was alright. We all got the all you can eat hot pot and bbq. The ambiance is pretty good and service was fast. I felt that it had a really large space. What was cool though was that for the all you can eat this place h each individual have their own hot pot. They also have this deal where if it's your birthday you can eat for free if you bring a minimum party of at least 4 people. I enjoyed the hot pot and the bbq. The bbq the main thing I would recommend  would be the steak and Korean bbq ribs. Those are amazing and you get unlimited! For bbq it was alright  for an all you can eat. It can't compare to a specialize Korean bbq place but the combination of hot pot and bbq is not a bad deal. On top of this if it's your bday you can eat for free if you have a party of 4. I recommend trying this out.

Nothing beats 99 Favor's birthday deal. We probably even ordered too much meats but we tried our best and powered through. The meat cuts aren't the best but for the deal, it's worth it. If anything, maybe we'll do the hot pot next time instead of kbbq. It was a Monday evening so it wasn't crowded at all and staff were easily around if needed. The sauce bar was a little messy but it was fine. Overall, I love coming here for birthday dinners!

It has been a while since we dined here, and good to Know food is still good and service is great. We ordered food through iPad and they came super fast, so no need to  order lots in advance..

They still have the promo where birthday person gets to eat for free. 

There were lots of people coming for group celebratory meals.

We will be back again!

Was disappointed with this place. First off, we all had to get the same thing (hot pot and/or bbq), we couldn't get one or the other... the service was okay, not great. The quality of the food was good but everything else lacked flavor.

Had a wonder birthday meal here. The staff were friendly and food was fresh. I like that we can order everything on the iPad. The sauce selection was also very good. To redeem the birthday meal, you must dine in on the day of your birthday with a minimum of 2 guests.

I have been a returning customer at your restaurant and have always enjoyed both the food and the service in the past. However, during my most recent visit, I experienced several significant issues regarding service clarity, safety, and customer support.

Previously, staff prepared and grilled the meat at the table. On recent visits, the service model shifted to self-service without clear communication to guests. During my latest meal, after waiting without guidance, I began grilling the meat myself, only for a staff member to step in midway through. 

Subsequently, staff placed food on the grill but left it unattended for extended periods, causing it to smoke heavily.

Shortly after, a severe flare-up occurred when grease caused large flames and heavy smoke to erupt from the grill, splattering hot grease onto me. Three staff members responded, and when one opened the cabinet beneath the table, a cloud of trapped smoke escaped into the dining room. Rather than addressing the hazard, staff inaccurately accused me of pouring oil onto the grill. The smoke eventually triggered the building's fire alarm, resulting in the response of the FDNY and prematurely ending our meal.

When I raised these concerns with the manager, the only resolution offered was a $4 discount on the bill. Given the physical hazard, poor communication, and inappropriate handling of the situation by the staff, this response was deeply disappointing.

I hope management takes these safety and service concerns seriously to prevent similar incidents in the future.

My go-to spot for birthday dinners- it is so reliable! They do require you to show IDs now, but the birthday person gets to eat for free! If you have a larger party they'll also put you upstairs in a more "private" space. I make sure to book ahead of time.

Pretty standard hot pot where you have your self-service sauce bar (though last I went some sauces were slightly watered down), and the waiters bringing in your AYCE picks.

This eatery is excellent. My pals and I enjoyed our BBQ and hotpot meals. The personnel served customers promptly and with great assistance. I appreciate that we may purchase our own sauces for our meals. Without a doubt, I will return.
We had so much fun here really great service a really comprehensive sauce bar and the meat/broth options were super tasty!

Celebrated a friend birthday with Korean BBQ so with a party of 2, you pay the price of one person. Had the Angus steak, shrimp, pork belly, Bulgogi, mushrooms, zucchini, and beef fillet. All were good except the Bulgogi tasted a bit weird. Drinks are not included and same for appetizers. Service was friendly and quick and ambiance was like in ancient China. Bathroom was nasty with graffiti on the walls.

Do you have a birthday coming up? Then 99 Favor Taste is a great spot to go! Like who can resist a free birthday meal. They do have some restrictions these days. (Free Birthday Meal with Party of 2 on Birth Date OR  Party of 4, Before / After 3 Days of Birth Date)

They have a good variety of options and every time we go we order so.much food! (I feel bad for the person grilling for us ) Luckily the grillers are very friendly, if you engage with them they will have small talks with you. Otherwise, they will only come over to.grill when needed.

Honestly, even without the birthday deal. The prices are very affordable, so it's a great go to spot if you want a good bang for your buck!

I really love this hot pot and BBQ buffet; they offer a wide variety of options for both hot pot and BBQ food. In the back section, there is an assortment of sauces, snacks, and fresh fruit to satisfy a diverse range of tastes. The dining environment is spacious and comfortable, making it an ideal spot for family gatherings.
Nice Chinese hotpot place with great service here!  They also offer bbq, but we didn't try it this time.  Maybe next time when we visit NYC.
Good food amazing service come ready to eat you can make your own sauce and must trust the teas

I'm not someone who typically writes dramatic reviews, but this experience was extremely disappointing.

I stopped by for the complimentary birthday meal that I've enjoyed here for the past several years. In the past, if you came in on your actual birthday, you could receive the birthday meal even if you were dining alone. I've always tipped 20%+ based on the full menu value and have also dined at your restaurants as a paying customer on many other occasions.

When I arrived, a supervisor at the front told me the policy had changed and said I should have checked the website beforehand. I pulled up the website on the spot and showed her that it had not been updated to reflect the new policy. She acknowledged that the website was inaccurate, but simply shrugged.

I politely explained that I had checked the website before making the trip and that it should be updated to avoid situations like this. Her demeanor then became noticeably dismissive.

Being turned away on my birthday after commuting there and looking forward to dinner was unnecessarily frustrating and, frankly, felt a bit petty.

Went to 99 Favor Taste for dinner on a Sunday evening and had a great experience. We did the Hot Pot and BBQ combo and enjoyed both.

Good variety of items that can be selected, friendly and helpful staff.

It was just normal. But I liked the square seating a lot. Shitty selection of sides and desserts compared to easy joy? Meat was mid and in general I felt like there weren't that many options?

Still AYCE and sauce bar carried so it's not bad. Ice cream for dessert but it's the small cheap cup kind.

Been here for two of my birthdays, and many group dinners. You eat for free on your birthday so definitely take advantage of that! I love this place. Quality food, huge space. I love the sauce bar too. I literally tell everyone about how much I love this spot! Service is super fast too. Super fun dining experience for a reasonable price!

Booked this place for a friends birthday party. It listed private rooms on the Google page so I called and inquired about their private room and they assured me it was indeed private. Once we arrived, they put us in a communal seating area and said the dividers to make the room semi-private were broken. Very disappointing. They didn't explain to us how to order, just left an iPad on the table. Once we figured out how to order and food started coming out- they only put one burner on for us. The burner was not heating up And it was taking so long to cook the thinnest pieces of meat. The meat was not good quality either. They finally turned on a second burner but it wouldn't really cook the food. We ran out of time of course. At one point, I was eating mostly raw meat and A few of my friends were sick after. The staff was nice and doing the best they could but this effectively ruined our birthday celebration. Thanks 99 flavor taste! :)

Have been eyeing the free birthday meal sign since October. Came here for birthday hot pot (with 3 ppl and 2 days after) but...Hot pot AND bbq for $40?! Great value. However, as predicted, was overwhelming to be both boiling and bbq-ing. Pretty big place to accommodate many big parties. Meat and veg is delicious! and great selection of create-your-own-sauce bar. Even get ice cream per person. Would come again but mainly for hotpot.

Some friends and I came here for Galentine's and we were hella yapping for hours so they were definitely trying to shoo us along when they placed the check on the table but was that our signal to leave? Not quite. All that to say is that they're not strict on the 2 hr limit or charging extra for leftover food although we tried our very best not to waste anything. I like how big the tables were, it was very spacious and held everything we ordered with plenty of room. We ended up each getting our own pot instead of sharing broth because we wanted to try a bunch of flavors. Everything was pretty tasty

Loved the pineapples here -- super sweet and refreshing, a perfect balance to the savory dishes. The all-you-can-eat hot pot and BBQ options make this spot great for groups, and the waiters were very accommodating and attentive, especially with refills and pacing. The menu has a huge variety, so everyone can find something they like, whether you're into meats, seafood, or veggies. The lively atmosphere makes it fun for group dinners or celebrations, and the value for the quality and quantity is hard to beat. Would definitely come back with friends.

One of the best AYCE hot pot places in the city. Great selection of meats at a very fair price, plus great broths to choose from. You can order from an iPad to your table directly which makes service fast and easy! The sauce bar has everything else you'll need.

Walked pass by this plane many many times before. Glad we finally stopped here for lunch. Did the dual hotpot and bbq. Cheaper than other hotpot places in Chinatown. Good selection was ok, but I love the bbq here. Mostly bc the secret sauce they have. I enjoyed the pumpkin bbq so delicious. Service was great altho I usually don't need much service. I usually grab what I can bc I know the waiters work hard. Vibe is family friendly. Definitely will come back again for food with friends

Service: 3.8/5
Food: 3.6/5
Price: $40-$60

Like most people, I came here for a friend's birthday- I heard the birthday song like 10 times over the course of my meal.

It's pretty standard (broths, ingredients, sauces, + time limit). Only subpar areas would be hot/cold bar (only french fries) + desserts (oranges, butterfly cookies, Chinese sugar donuts, ice cream cups- out by 9PM).

I'm not sure if weekends are always fully packed or if we just went on a particularly busy weekend. As such, we had to flag down staff for water/broth refills + extra utensils. We ordered 3 rounds + only had to follow up on some items from our 3rd, at ~9PM. Also, it was SO WARM inside from beginning to end, the soup steam really builds up.

We went for a birthday celebration eating on BBQ for 12 people. We were told we had an hour and thirty minutes to eat. We started cooking and realized the grills were weak. It legitimately took nearly 30 minutes to cook a steak and it was still red. Then we called our waiter over, which he replaced the entire grill which the entire situation took nearly half our time without eating. We ordered multiple orders of certain meat dishes and it seems to be a random amount they give. How do we order 3 orders of short rib and get 1 piece. How come 5 orders of lettuce  comes out to barely 1 basket enough for one person. The inconsistency is frustrating. How do they expect us to cook meat fast enough for 12 people if the grills literally take 20 minutes to cook a batch. And I say "batch" but it's barely enough for half the table. And our compensation was a bottle of tea. 40 dollars to still be hungry at an all you can eat is unheard of. I've came here before to get QUANTITY over QUALITY, but if they're gonna cheap out on grills so we can barely cook, then what's the point of ever going here.

We came here to celebrate a birthday and the experience was incredibly disappointing. The service was extremely inattentive from start to finish. Every time we placed an order, at least one item was missing, and we constantly had to remind the servers about things we already asked for.

Drinks took an unusually long time to arrive, even though the restaurant wasn't overly busy. On top of that, the servers were rude and unhelpful when we tried to follow up or ask questions, which really killed the vibe for what was supposed to be a celebration.

To make matters worse, besides the actual meat portion, you have to pay for every single side, which was not clearly explained and felt very misleading--especially given the price point.

KBBQ is meant to be an interactive and enjoyable experience, but the lack of attention, poor attitude, and unexpected extra charges made it frustrating instead. Definitely not a place I'd return to, especially for a special occasion.

Ambiance is okay nothing special, service was quick. The food itself was good next time I go here instead of doing the dual hot pot and bbq id go with just bbq. The food options were imo slightly better. Don't forget to grab your free small ice cream by the sauce stand!

It's super packed on weekends, so be prepared for a wait. IMO hot pot is more fun with a group, so bring your friends and cook together. The service is spotty, it can be hard to flag someone down. Also the sauce area is messy, but nonetheless it is AYCE and decent quality. Definitely left here full every time.

Haven't been back in a while, but they also had free ice cream you can grab from the freezer. Hope this is still there next time I visit.

The tomato broth was really bland. Veggies were good but meat and seafood were both just okay. Portion wise is worth for what you pay for and I will say it's one of the cheaper AYCE spots out there. Service was quick and it's a bonus that there was no wait but overall this place was just ok!

I wouldn't come back here since the service was just horrible. Truly understandable that, they are closing during this hour but having that attitude on kicking a whole group while we didn't finish our food shows that, it's not worth to come back especially it's someone's birthday. Even the meat isn't fresh at all. 
The way we were treated during the service was utterly disappointing. They didn't bring the order that we wanted on the tablet and we were treated with cold shoulders as if, they didn't want to serve us on a special day. 
Even they blast up "happy birthday" songs, it wasn't festive at all and nobody wasn't even singing which gives an awkward vibe and experience.
Not only the meat was not fresh, we were placed on an unsettling seats where we were near the trash, the bins of dishes were on the floor which god forbid, someone could've have tripped and fall down. The environment was unsanitary too. So highly suggest, go somewhere else where you get treated nicely, get better quality of food for the better price and quantity of it. 
If you wanna get the sauces, they wouldn't even refill the sauces at all and even if you ask, they wouldn't want to do it at all. It's even unsanitary for them to not clean the sauce station at all.

We've been coming here for YEARS. Food, service, and quality have been steadily declining through the years. Now they force all guests to get the same items regardless in a scummy effort to rip people off. The service has gone to hell with the staff being lazy and unwilling to help along with jacked up prices to top it all off. And the clientele has severely degrades. It is no longer enjoyable for us to come here. Plenty of alternatives at this point to choose from. I suggest you take a look elsewhere.​

99 Favor Taste is known for having a great birthday special (free for the birthday person! with some conditions on party size depending on if you come the day of), and that's what we came for recently.

Our party of two had a reservation for 6:30 on a weekday, but it wasn't quite needed since the place was very empty when we got there (it did fill up slowly over the next few hours). We both opted for the hot pot (not BBQ), and there's a selection of 5 or 6 (?) broths to choose from. Mine was a classic pork bone base, which was fine, but nothing ~too special.

The AYCE ordering is done on a tablet, and what's nice is that I think they somewhat calibrate the portion sizes of the food you order based on your party size (they gave us relatively small portions of most of our veggies, which was perfect for us to try many things). The meat options were pretty good -- I liked the fatty beef the most.

Service was somewhat brusque but we didn't have to interact with them too often (bc we would just order solely via the tablet).

Overall price point was fine (a bit pricey). I think AYCE is intended for quantity, not quality, and I think our meal definitely reflected that. I'm not too sure I'd be too keen to come back on a regular day (i.e. not a birthday haha) -- but definitely one of the better options for free birthday *things* around the city.

Came here for hot pot this time, it's all you can eat. Quick service. You self serve your sauces at the sauce bar. Great spot to hangout on a cold night with a group of friends. We chose this spot because they have individual pots for my friends with different dietary restrictions like no beef or no gluten
AYCE hot pot with lots of protein options - but not many vegetable options. You can order easily and to your liking with the iPad, and make your own sauces at the bar.
Everything was good tasty The best hot pot Korean baroque around service was good I always go into a food coma after I leave

We came here as a party of 5. Two of us are on our birthday. We come to this restaurant every year because they have a policy that it's free for the birthday person. But now the policy has changed to for EVERY birthday person, you need a party of 4. So you would need a party of 8 for two birthday guests. However, this was not stated in their website. Very misleading.

All you can eat menu probably not the best idea for me. I want it all. The meats were quite good for the most part. The vegetables were fresh and crisp.. The service was excellent. The restaurant is quite noisy as you might expect for this type of offering.

We walked in on a week night and the restaurant was relatively empty. The place is huge and normally packed on weekends when I've been in the past. Service was fast and the price is a good deal for all you can eat. You order on a tablet and the items came out pretty quickly. We were stuffed! There are always lots of people celebrating their birthday here, so be ready to hear the birthday song over and over again....

I understand why this is such a popular place. Good deal, AYCE, convenient location, and a wide array of food. And it is! Just be prepared for a bit of a hectic experience.

Had a reservation for 7pm on a Saturday night but didn't get seated until 7.45pm which made me hangry. I liked that there was an IPad to order food which made things convenient. However, we didn't receive all the food we ordered and wasn't sure if our food was going to come later down the line. We had to flag servers down when we wanted stuff, as no one would come when we hit the call server button. 

But speaking about the food, I really enjoyed the hotpot broth and the sauce bar. My suggestion is to go 1.5-2x sesame sauce to peanut butter with some garlic and scallions mixed into it.

99 Favor Taste is a favorite hotpot spot in our household. My roommate and I would travel from Riverdale all the way down to Grand Street nearly every week during our university days. Their hotpot broth is wonderfully flavorful for the price and I was so ecstatic to see a new miso broth on the menu since it's something I'd been hoping for. The variation in the different food is typical of most hotpot place including noodles, meat, vegetables, and seafood. Their sauce bars are stacked with all you need to make the perfect sauce. Not to mention it's all you can eat for a very affordable price. The servers are very fast and efficient and take care when there is something we need. They are also very accommodating on the days we come as walk-ins when we weren't able to make a reservation. Nobody is ever dismissive, though do not expect to be tended to every single moment, only when needed or on occasion. Which I am fine with! I think it goes well with the 'self-serve' tablet method of getting food. It gives you and your party more time and room to take your time with the food in both eating and cooking to chat.
I love the interior of the restaurant it feels very warm, cozy, and homey which is perfect for hotpot. 

The hotpot will always be my favorite here, but the barbeque is also not something to be missed. It provides a nice different experience when one does not crave hotpot and more 'grilled' meats and veggies.

Though, very sad that their hours have been cut to 12, I miss when they would be open at 2. After a night out we'd always know 99 Favor would have our back on a weekend.

My go-to sauces? 
Sesame oil + load up on the garlic + soy sauce + scallion for a non-spicy, safer sauce that'll elevate any piece with sesame/umami flavor. Add chili oil for additional spice! 
Also love a good pancake sauce for a more tangy taste.

Fantastic AYCE hotpot deal, with a great variety of options. I liked the dumplings and thin noodles a lot. The fish balls were also good. It also came with ice cream at the end. Our table had individual small hotpots, which was nice to control our own. The meat was a bit tough in my opinion.

Small wait to be seated at 6:30 on a Friday, but there was a huge line by the time we left at 9ish.

Came here for my birthday dinner after a friend insisted we try it, and honestly, I was a little skeptical from the outside. The building looks kind of shady, if I'm being super blunt. But you walk in and it's super well-maintained and clean, which was a huge relief!

We did a walk-in on a Sunday, and even though it was busy, we got seated pretty fast. The service was truly excellent from start to finish. Our waiter kept checking on us and was super patient explaining the hot pot situation to my friends.
I stick to vegetarian options, so I loaded up on tofu, eggs, and tons of fresh veggies. My friends went hard on the meat options and everyone agreed the quality was great. 

The only tiny, weird thing was the condiment station. It felt tucked away in a corner, and the plates/bowls for sauces were tiny! We had to keep going back for more, which was a little annoying, but not a dealbreaker.

The cherry on top? Turns out the birthday meal is free for 1! That was a genuinely nice surprise and made the whole night feel special. Definitely recommend, just be prepared for the tiny sauce dishes.

AYCE, massive sauce bar, individual hot pot, tons of options from seafood to meats to veggies... even got the lil' ice cream at the end. TBH I don't think you can ask for more from a hot pot place, and it boasts such a massive interior in Chinatown I think this might be my new spot to host large groups.
I went there long time ago, but loved the ambiance back then, the food was great, kept eating and eating; service was pretty decent, felt as if the attentions were really nice
Great for large groups, we had about 10 people and felt like the space was enough to comfortably accommodate all of us. All you can eat is a great deal and I enjoyed all the options we got!

The staff remembers returning customers without being intrusive. Staff members show consistent skill. Their food satisfies completely and their staff always delivers. 99 Favor Taste - New York offers both a cool atmosphere and excellent service. This place shows superior standards.

It was fun coming here for my b-day with my wife. Hotpot was worth it but the BBQ was not. The ribeye steak was basically injected with butter and that's it. 

I enjoyed the service there. The server often came over to help turn the meats on the grill which I appreciated. They were so quick with picking up the trash and plates and with serving the meats and veggies.

My meal here struck all the right notes. The personnel demonstrate exceptional politeness and skill. This spot was surprisingly good. They give you enough food to feel full. I value the experience at 99 Favor Taste - New York!

I came here for a friend's birthday dinner, and it was a great time! For their birthday dinner, the birthday person gets a free meal, with a group of four or more. The interior of this restaurant is much nicer than it appears from the outside, and there's plenty of big tables for large groups. You order your items on an iPad and the staff comes out fairly quick with your food.

Here, you have the option to do both or either KBBQ and/or hotpot. This time, my friends and I just opted for their hotpot. They have a good variety of options (although less than I typically see for AYCE hotpot--ie. they only have 4 meat options) for veggies, meat, and seafood. They also have a variety of appetizers, such as the seafood pancake, that you can pay a little bit extra for. The hotpot itself is pretty solid and all of the ingredients are fresh. Overall, good value for the money and I would love to come back to try their BBQ.

I walk out of there smelling like hot pot and feeling full for DAYS. Get a bunch of meat and just load my hot pot up. On your birthday, if you bring a few friends, you can eat for free and when they sing happy birthday, some dude in the monkey king suit comes out. It's awesome. Ahh I miss this place.

I love love love hot pot and this is one of my favorite locations to check out in the middle of the day. Usually after I get a massage and facial from around the corner and need sustenance after my spa day. This place hits everytime. I roll up my sleeves, I tune out the world and I order everything I crave. I've been here way too many times to count. 

The meat selection is always fresh along with their seafood and meatball options. I love having access to super fresh and delicious veggies and Asian greens and all the other yummy options. The attendants are super sweet and it's a chill vibe. 10 outta 10 but if you plan to come with a large group later in the afternoon or at night add yourself to their reservation list so you won't wait as long showing up behind a queue!

You'll thank me later.

Used to be a good spot for cheap AYCE hotpot, but they've since raised prices and cut corners on quality. 

Price used to be $28/person, now it's $30/person. They use extremely cheap cuts of meat and their broths are extremely oily. The portions are also incredibly small.

The one thing that makes them good is the free meal on birthdays. That's it, no other redeeming qualities.

Consider checking out other AYCE hotpot around the city, my go-to is Happy Lamb Hotpot in Flushing, they're cheaper and better quality :)
This place has a really good AYCE deal for hotpot and kbbq. The food is really good and the service was nice too. The birthday deal here is really good, highly recommend
Great for birthday celebrations. We had a mixture of hot pot n some bbq combo too. So much yummy food. Great service!!!  Glad I finally tried it out!!!

PLEASE UPDATE YOUR WEBSITE WITH CORRECT INFORMATION SO PEOPLE DONT COME ALL THE WAY (TWO HOURS FOR ME) TO EAT JUST TO BE MISINFORMED AND TURNED AWAY ON THE DAY OF THEIR OWN BIRTHDAY

i came all the way up from south new jersey because i had confirmed via their website and countless tiktok videos that on the day of your birthday, you could eat alone for free (not to be confused with having to bring a party of four if you came three days before or after the day of your birthday). i had planned a really nice solo day up in new york city for myself and took an almost two hour trip to get up there only to be turned away despite pointing out the policy they had on their OWN WEBSITE. apparently on the day of your birthday, it needs to be a party of two. this is fine and understandable but it would have been nice to have known this information before hand because then i would have asked a friend to accompany me. asked to speak to a manager for any sort of accommodation but conveniently they "weren't in today". i left the restaurant in tears. went somewhere else to eat and yes i could have stayed and paid the price regardless and ate there but the whole situation was such a turn off i decided to get kbbq somewhere else even if it wasnt for free. its about the principle. run your business better.

Definitely wouldn't recommend if your with one friend he paid for one seat and I went with him so he paid to dine in then he gave about to bites of his meat and the staff instaly said that there gonna charge us for 2 so in total they said it would be 87$ with tip and my friend went for him self to eat not for me so it was confusing they said even if we eat one bite they charge you for it but just simply they dont tell you it's a buffet for all you can eat so then we told them they didn't tell us that but then the employee got mad and lied to the manger and told her she told us that we he told us it was a buffet but never did the staff stared at us after and then cursed me and my friend out in there language it was very annoying and irritating but then we walked out the door and they looked us in disgust but even the manger sided with the employees. And also cursed us out I wouldn't recommend beacuse they don't tell you there hidden fees

Went back here the past weekend after boxing because it was very cold and it was just necessary. Although I wrote a review about this place in the past, had to drop it by a star because quality really went down. I am not sure if they were low on staffing and it was MLK that it was a different moment than usual, but it was very disappointing. 

First let's talk condiment section, a lot of it was either empty or it was messy. It did not give me a good feeling when I went there.
